description: This file provides environment variable parsing, validation, and utility functions for managing Django settings with an emphasis on safety and correct configuration in different deployment environments.

methods.name: bool _truthy(val: str)
methods.description: Converts a string value to boolean based on common truthy values.

methods.name: bool env_bool(name: str, default: bool = False)
methods.description: Reads a boolean environment variable with support for various true/false representations.

methods.name: Optional[str] env_str(name: str, default: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Reads an environment variable as a string, returning a default if missing or blank.

methods.name: List[str] env_list(name: str, default: Optional[List[str]] = None)
methods.description: Parses an environment variable as a list, supporting JSON array, comma-separated, or whitespace-separated formats.

methods.name: str require_env(name: str, *, hint: str = "")
methods.description: Enforces that a specific environment variable is set and non-empty, raising ImproperlyConfigured if not.

methods.name: None validate_settings( *, debug: bool, environment: str, allowed_hosts: Optional[List[str]] = None, payment_mode: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Performs key validation checks on settings such as DEBUG mode, SECRET_KEY, ALLOWED_HOSTS, and payment configuration, ensuring they meet security and consistency requirements.
